verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a game engine with a scripting API and a keyless Asset Library JSON API could plausibly publish a machine-readable spec. However, every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returned 404. The Asset Library JSON endpoint is a queryable API, not a downloadable spec describing it, so it earns no credit. No evidence shows an equivalent machine-readable API description.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
